values.meaning: bonus magic damage on critical strikes
values.binNote: Bin models this as a 10% + 0.1%-per-AP amplification of the critical strike's pre-mitigation damage, not a flat percent damage value; wiki phrasing '10% (+10% per 100 AP) bonus magic damage' matches 0.1 + 0.001xap as a multiplier on crit damage.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike, before mitigation.
mechanics.quote: The '''bonus''' damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}}.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage applies life steal.
If the critical strike is already magic damage, the passive amps it directly; otherwise it deals the bonus as a separate new instance of magic damage tagged as a critical strike.
mechanics.quote: If the ''critical strike'' is {{as|magic damage}} then ''Vow of the First Lands'' amps it directly. Otherwise, it deals it as a new instance of {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} tagged as having ''critically struck''.

mechanics.claim: When dealt as a new instance, that instance can itself critically strike again, causing the passive to apply again as an amp on itself.
mechanics.quote: When dealt as a new instance, it can ''critically strike'' again (e.g {{ii|Shadowflame}}), successivelly causing ''Vow of the First Lands'' to apply again on itself as an amp.
